source: Windows test VM, Kontakt 8 + Spitfire Symphony Orchestra, offline renders by kthost (2026-10-10); events by tools/soundlibraries/performance_context/gen.py, which copies the rules of MuseScore Recommended (dumpEvents of Whence 12-TET): Spiccato (CC32 42) at the calibrated velocity, sent its onset early, off at half its IOI; Performance Legato on the Performance patch at the calibrated CC1, attack 112 sent the median Legato onset early, transitions 93 (Violas 100) overlapping 24 ms, re-attack 106 with the note before it ending 54 ms before
metric: the owner's: loudest 50 ms RMS (5 ms hop) per note from note-on to max(off, on + 150 ms) + 50 ms, mono; median per figure; L plain, K after BS.1770 K-weighting; two takes (B in reverse order), averaged
figure: staccatos: 6 notes [p, p-2, p, p+1, p, p-2] at 2 x IOI; slurs: [p, p-2, p, p+1] from silence (attack) then [p+2, p, p+2, p+3] (re-attack), at IOI; 3 s between slur figures, 1.5 s between staccato figures
relation: need = staccatos - slurs + 1.3 dB: the gain on the Performance notes over their calibrated CC1 that gives staccatos - slurs = -1.3 dB (the Violas' approved relation)

Violins 1.note: need, st (staccatos), pf (slurs at the calibrated CC1 cc), a / b (slurs from silence / re-attacked), pf64 / a64 (slurs at CC1 64), max127 (what CC1 127 adds over cc), dB
